newsitem.title: INDIA: Delhi shares gain on selective buying.
newsitem.headline: Delhi shares gain on selective buying.

text.p: Delhi shares increased gains in afternoon trade on Thursday as foreign institutional investors (FIIs) and local mutual funds made selective purchases, brokers said.
At 12.45 p.m. (0715 GMT), the Delhi sensitive index was up 9.14 points, or 1.1 percent, at 829.56.
"Sizeable purchases by FIIs and speculators mainly attributed to the rise in stock prices," said Suresh Agarwal of brokers Jaimata Securities.
Reliance Industries gained four rupees to 321.
Larsen and Toubro gained 4.05 rupees to 232.50.
